identity.name: E1
identity.mission: Create a premium, executive, and trustworthy Confidential Information Memorandum (CIM) Document Portal for TessaAuthority.com.
identity.aesthetic: Old Money Tech meets Swiss Grid

primary.description: Midnight Blue - Deep, stable, corporate anchor.

secondary.description: Platinum Grey - Soft contrast for secondary actions.

accent.description: Burnished Gold - Luxury highlights, use sparingly.

background.description: Off-white paper for public, Deep Obsidian for deal room.

usage_rules.gradients: NO gradients on text. Subtle, almost invisible gradients on backgrounds allowed (e.g., bg-gradient-to-b from-white to-gray-50).
usage_rules.text_contrast: Body text must be #374151 or darker on light backgrounds. Headings #111827.
usage_rules.brand_identity: Use Gold (#C5A059) ONLY for primary CTAs or active states. Do not overuse.

public_landing.rules: Asymmetry is key. Hero spans 8 cols, Feature spans 4.

admin_portal.rules: Dense data. Use full height. No jagged bottoms.

alignment.headings: text-left (Center only for standalone hero sections)

buttons.style: Sharp or slightly rounded (rounded-sm). NO pill shapes.

cards.style: Flat, 1px border (#E5E7EB), white background. Shadow-sm on hover only.

inputs.style: h-11 rounded-sm border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm ring-offset-background file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-sm file:font-medium placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50

textures.noise: Use a subtle noise overlay (opacity 0.02) on solid backgrounds to reduce digital flatness.

hero_background.alt: Modern skyscrapers against a cloudy sky - Symbolizing growth and stability
hero_background.usage: Hero section background with dark overlay (bg-black/40) for text readability.

login_background.alt: Modern office space with dining area and glass partition
login_background.usage: Split screen login page. Image on left/right, form on solid color.

texture_accent.alt: Abstract golden spiral on black background
texture_accent.usage: Subtle background for 'Premium/Protected' section cards or headers.

general: Follow the 'Anti-AI Designer' persona: No generic layouts, no 'Inter' everywhere.
Use 'Libre Baskerville' for all headings. It differentiates the brand instantly.
Implement the 'Tetris Grid' for the landing page. Do not just stack sections vertically.
Ensure all interactive elements have `data-testid` attributes.
accessibility: Ensure contrast ratio of 4.5:1 for normal text.
Focus states must be clearly visible (ring-2 ring-offset-2 ring-primary).
Use semantic HTML (header, main, footer, article, section).

universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped (overridden to sharp for this project), or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
